description: Add controls to a composition's Essential Graphics panel (Animation > Add Property to Essential Graphics): properties such as Source Text, colours, sliders, checkboxes, angles, 2D points and scale, Dropdown Menu Controls (optionally setting their menu items) and 3D shadow colour, or footage and precomposition layers as media replacement. A nested composition then shows them as Essential Properties

comp.description: Which composition. Give its item id (from list_items) or name; omit for the active composition

menuItems.description: For a Dropdown Menu Control's Menu property: the menu items (unique, no "|")

property.description: A property: a shortcut (anchor_point, position, scale, rotation, opacity, x_rotation, y_rotation, orientation, source_text, time_remap, audio_levels) or a path of match names or display names from the layer, e.g. ["ADBE Effect Parade", "Gaussian Blur", "Blurriness"]. Omit to add the layer itself as media replacement

name: add_essential_graphics_controls
title: Add Essential Graphics Controls
